decisions.reason: Box trailers are central to the firm's established range and likely still meet aspirations, though their absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.
The high-cover series complements the core trailers and needs few extra resources, so the firm's slack lets it carry the product despite weak visibility evidence.

As a second box trailer series overlapping with B and absent from the website in recent years, it likely falls short of aspirations, and consolidating into B frees resources for core business and new development.
